offence_note: Aggravated assault by driving vehicle at pedestrian
sentence_quote: the trial judge sentenced the appellant to imprisonment for a term of 18 months and ordered that he comply with the terms of a probation order for a period of two years after completion of the term of imprisonment
note: Sentence appeal dismissed; mitigating factors not specified.

offence_note: Over 80 driving and driving while prohibited
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and allow the appeal to the extent of setting aside the probation order but I would otherwise dismiss the appeal.
note: Probation order set aside as illegal; also 10-year provincial prohibition not appealed.

offence_note: Robbery as getaway driver and use of imitation firearm
sentence_quote: A consecutive mandatory minimum one-year sentence was imposed for the use of an imitation firearm. The effective sentence for the two offences was therefore two years.
note: 12 months robbery (8 after credit) plus consecutive 12 months; lifetime firearms prohibition.

offence_note: Sexual interference and sexual touching of a child
sentence_quote: Mr. Hughes will be sentenced on the s. 151 charge of sexual interference to six-years in custody.
note: Victim Indigenous, offender not; s. 271 stayed under Kienapple; concurrent terms; s.109 for 10 years, SOIRA life.

offence_note: Failing to stop after accident causing death
sentence_quote: I have concluded that two years less a day plus two years' probation is appropriate.
note: Court found no mitigating circumstances; age and health considered only in choosing length and institution.

sentence_quote: For that offence, you are sentenced to nine months imprisonment.
note: Conditional sentence rejected; s.109 prohibition 10 years; $100 surcharge.

offence_note: Criminal harassment of former spouse; unauthorized firearms possession
sentence_quote: On Count 1, which is the charge of criminal harassment, I sentence you to three years' imprisonment, followed by probation for three years on the conditions I will outline shortly.
note: 3 years plus 10 months consecutive; mitigating only polite conduct in court; credit 17 months at 1.5:1.

offence_note: Three breaches of long-term supervision order
sentence_quote: For the three offences to which you have pleaded guilty, I sentence you to a global sentence of 14 months' imprisonment.
note: Joint submission accepted; Indigenous status and Ipeelee noted but weight not stated.

sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the Appellant to 5 months’ imprisonment in a correctional facility
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; appellant asked that no conditional sentence be imposed.

offence_note: Offence not stated in text shown
sentence_quote: we would grant leave to appeal sentence, but dismiss the appeal.
note: Custodial portion already served, length and offence not shown; probation length not shown.

offence_note: Illegal sale of cannabis from dispensary under Cannabis Act
sentence_quote: I sentence Daniels to a suspended sentence with two years’ probation.
note: Open medical dispensary treated as lower moral blameworthiness; 12-month curfew and 100 hours community service as probation terms.
